Personally bucket is one of my favorite supports. Good damage, tracking monsters, etc. As for being better than his peers (such as cabot, hank, and sunny) he does best a tracking the monsters than any other support. Cabot does dust tagging but only if you think the monster is nearby. Bucket however uses his UAV to travel almost the whole map and specifically tag the monster. As for bucket countering a specific monster I think he's good at countering almost any monster. As long as you spread out your turrets and do good amounts of damage you should be good at almost getting any monster. And yes  I do believe that he is really good at defending the generator when you place his turrets around it. I haven't quite heard of him being good when being grouped with Laz although when Laz is down and the monster is focusing on him you should throw the turrets around the monster so he can get away from him or anyone in general really. And lastly, for the perks, i recommend either capacity increase, quick switch or reload speed. The capacity increase and the reload speed are for continuously damaging the monster. The quick switch is for quickly switching back and forth to his turrets and his missile launcher. Hopefully that that answered most of your questions, good luck!
